grupales.title: Taiwan
grupales.shortDescription: Explore the green island of Asia, from its misty mountains to its vibrant culture.
grupales.description:
Taiwan is a hidden treasure for nature and culture lovers. On this expedition with Diana Adventure, we will delve into lush National Parks like Taroko, famous for its impressive marble gorges, and hike the trails of Alishan among ancient forests.

True to our mission, we work with local communities to ensure our visit supports the conservation of mountain ecosystems and offers an authentic cultural immersion, from night markets to traditional tea plantations, guaranteeing minimal environmental impact.

grupales.title: Magical Torres del Paine
grupales.shortDescription: Enjoy an unforgettable experience in the heart of Chilean Patagonia. A trip designed to connect with wild nature.
grupales.description:
Enjoy an unforgettable experience in the heart of Chilean Patagonia. A trip designed to connect with wild nature, hike imposing trails, and contemplate landscapes unique in the world.

Minimum group: 6 passengers.

🗺️ Day-by-Day Itinerary:

• Day 1: Welcome to Patagonia and First Views
Meeting: Group reception at the Puerto Natales Airport.
Route to the park: Direct transfer to Hostería Pehoé, located in the heart of Torres del Paine.
Daily Activities: Visit to the Cueva del Milodón Natural Monument (subject to opening hours) and Trekking along the Condor Trail, a perfect natural viewpoint for panoramic postcards of the Paine Massif.

• Day 2: Photographic Safari and Paine Viewpoints
Vehicle exploration: Panoramic tour designed to capture the park's contrasts.
Key points to visit: Grey Beach (views of icebergs), Villa Monzino, Sarmiento Gate, Amarga Lagoon, the impressive Paine Waterfall, and Azul Lagoon.

• Day 3: The Great Challenge (Route to Choose)
Main Option - Base Torres Trail (High Difficulty): Patagonia's most famous hike. Demanding but rewarding, crowning at the turquoise lagoon at the foot of the imposing monolithic towers.
Alternative Option - French Valley Trail (Medium/High Difficulty): Hike towards the granite wall amphitheater in the heart of the W circuit. (Note: This option requires the extra catamaran payment at Pehoé Lake).

• Day 4: Wildlife Tracking and Return
Morning adventure: Hike along the Aonikenk Trail, an area of Patagonian steppe ideal for spotting local wildlife such as guanacos, foxes, and, with luck, the elusive puma.
Farewell: Return by private transport to the city of Puerto Natales to conclude the services.
includes: Transfers: Private round-trip transportation from Puerto Natales to the hotel inside the park.
Route Leader: Certified driver-guide throughout the journey.
Accommodation: Stay at the iconic Hostería Pehoé with breakfast included.
Adventures: Daily guided excursions according to the itinerary.
Trail rations: Daily snacks for the hikes.
excludes: Entrance fees to Torres del Paine National Park and Cueva del Milodón Monument.
Pehoé Lake catamaran tickets (needed for French Valley option).

grupales.title: Japan
grupales.shortDescription: Experience the contrast between ancient tradition and the vibrant nature of the land of the rising sun.
grupales.description:
Discover a Japan beyond the neon and big cities. With Diana Adventure, we take you to explore ancient pilgrimage routes and immerse yourself in the serenity of the Japanese Alps, hidden shrines, and majestic bamboo forests.

Our expedition combines respect for traditions with our ecological commitment. We will experience staying in traditional ryokans, enjoying local hospitality, and connecting with a culture that reveres nature in every aspect of its daily life, shaping more conscious travelers.
includes: Air tickets and transportation (includes JR bullet train passes)
Stay in boutique hotels and Ryokans (traditional accommodation)

grupales.title: Scotland
grupales.shortDescription: Delve into the Highlands: castles, mysterious lochs, and epic landscapes.
grupales.description:
The Scottish Highlands await us with their dramatic landscapes, deep glens, and fascinating history. On this route, we will explore from the Isle of Skye to enigmatic lochs, hiking trails surrounded by rugged nature and towering mountains.

True to our essence, we prioritize contact with rural communities and support conservation projects seeking to restore and protect ancient Scottish ecosystems. Each excursion is designed to leave a positive footprint and lead you to adventure sustainably.

valdivia.title: Birdwatching Valdivia
valdivia.shortDescription: Kayak tour through the Cutipay River nature sanctuary.
valdivia.description:
From Valdivia, we head to the town of Cutipay, located 12 km west of the city, home to the Cutipay River and nature sanctuary. There, we will take a kayak tour along the river to observe the birds found in the wetland. The journey will be conducted with the utmost care, trying not to scare away the birds or invade their nests.

Our main guide for this excursion is Rodrigo, who has extensive experience in natural areas...

valdivia.title: Alerce Costero National Park Hiking
valdivia.shortDescription: Guided trekking to the imposing ancient alerce tree with observation of native flora and fauna.
valdivia.description:
Pick up is provided in the city of Valdivia, heading towards the Alerce Costero National Park, located approximately 2.5 hours away. Upon entering the park, we will access the trail to the ancient alerce tree. During the 5 km round trip, we can observe a great diversity of local flora with high chances of spotting wildlife, mainly birds.

* Important recommendations: 
- Wear comfortable outdoor clothing.
- Bring sunglasses.
